comment: BLOCKWAVE recipe book — 16 hidden recipes. Schema: docs/RECIPES_FORMAT.md, design rationale: docs/RECIPE_NOTES.md. The first 8 are the spec recipes (docs/CRAFT_GRID.md); their PATTERNS ARE FROZEN against src/CraftEngine.h specRecipePatterns() and the state tests enforce the sync — only the override params are hand-tuned here. Recipes 9-16 are the Phase 4 additions. Every 'params' block is a DIFF applied on top of the plain craft result for that exact grid; the per-recipe 'note' names the SOUND_DESIGN technique(s) and is ignored by the parser.

recipes.name: PERMAFROST
recipes.note: technique 1 PWM pad + 13 cave ambience. Plain ICE x3 rails unison to 8 at 35c and clamps release to 5 s; the override backs unison off the rail, deepens and slows the PWM, darkens the filter with keytrack so chords speak two octaves up, and turns CAVE into a big damped ice cavern.

recipes.name: MAGMA FLOOR
recipes.note: technique 6 sub-anchored bass + LAVA grind. OBSIDIAN x2 rounds oscA to oct -2, so plain craft plays a subsonic mush at 212 Hz cutoff; the override brings the oscillator back to -1, opens the filter into the growl band with keytrack, and makes the crush a musical 6-bit grind instead of a dull 10-bit haze. Mono + micro-glide makes it playable.

recipes.name: QUARRY KICK
recipes.note: technique 8 chip kick. Plain TNT x2 clamps env2_pitch to -48 st, which in this engine sweeps the pitch UP into the note, and stacks noise to 1.0 — a rising hiss, not a kick. The override flips the pitch envelope to a descending +30 st / 55 ms drop, cuts the noise back to a short-LFSR crack, and lands the body at 210 Hz for a near-sine thump with a 7-bit crunch.

recipes.name: SHARDSTORM
recipes.note: technique 5 sync scream + 7 pitch-env + ping-pong shards. CRYSTAL x4 clamps oscB to +12 st, where hard sync is nearly inaudible (it just reads as an octave); moving the sync partial to +7 restores the metallic formant. A faster, deeper pitch chirp gives every note its shard, 8.2 kHz replaces the 15 kHz fizz, and 1/8 ping-pong scatters the storm.

recipes.name: FOREST LULLABY
recipes.note: technique 3 hollow keys + 11 lo-fi haze + 13 cave. CLOUD pushes the attack to 310 ms, which is unplayable as KEYS; the override restores a 12 ms attack and rebuilds the note as a long piano-ish decay-to-quiet-sustain, brightens just enough to be present under the tape crush, and keytracks so the top octave does not vanish.

recipes.name: MIDAS MODE
recipes.note: technique 4 supersquare, polished. Plain GOLD x4 gets the width but keeps the CHIP envelope (30 ms decay, 35 ms release) and a raw 20 kHz top, so it reads as a thin blip. The override pushes the stack to a full 8-voice 26-cent supersquare, adds a fine-detune sheen, gives it decay/release bloom and a dotted-1/8 ping-pong, and tames the top to 9.5 kHz so the gold is bright, not fizzy.

recipes.name: STRATOSPHERE
recipes.note: technique 13 cave ambience + 1 PWM. CLOUD x8 drives cave_mix to 0.95 and the osc level to 0.50 — almost pure reverb with no source left. The override restores a dry core, widens the stack to 6 voices at 20 cents, sets the slowest possible 8/1 PWM drift for glacial motion, and keeps CAVE huge but bright-tailed with a half-note ping-pong behind it.

recipes.name: ICICLE HARP
recipes.note: technique 7 pitch-env pluck + 2 thin pulse. Plain GLASS x2 gives the thin 14% pulse and some delay but no pitch envelope at all, so it is a filter blip. The override adds the +14 st / 60 ms mallet chirp that makes it a harp, opens a real filter sweep with keytrack, lengthens the ring, and turns the delay into a dotted-1/8 ping-pong with a breath of cave.

recipes.name: TARPIT
recipes.note: NEW (bottom row). technique 14 SLIME wub. SLIME x3 wobbles the pulse width but leaves the filter parked at 650 Hz, so nothing actually wobbles in the low end. The override moves LFO2 to the cutoff (tri, 1/8, +-2.5 octaves around 240 Hz) for the real wub and hands the pulse-width motion to the free LFO1, so the sound has two independent wobbles; mono + 85 ms glide makes it slide like tar.

recipes.name: THUNDER SEAM
recipes.note: NEW (right column). technique 9 NES metallic + 12 RAW dirt. VOLT x3 supplies 1/16 PWM and a sample-and-hold cutoff jitter, but at a wide-open 20 kHz cutoff the jitter is inaudible. The override closes the filter to 5.2 kHz with keytrack so every s&h step is heard, switches RAW on for authentic aliasing, and blends a short-mode LFSR layer for the robotic clang. 1/16 ping-pong turns the jitter into a machine.

recipes.name: COBBLE THUMP
recipes.note: NEW (four corners). technique 8 chip drums + 12 RAW. STONE x4 already gives the bone-dry, aliased, no-reverb character and a 17 ms release; what it does not give is a usable drum, because the inherited PERC pitch envelope sweeps upward. The override flips it to a descending +24 st / 70 ms tom drop, adds a short-LFSR stick click, and keytracks hard at 0.8 so one recipe covers the whole tom range.

recipes.name: GEYSER
recipes.note: NEW (bottom row + top centre). technique 13 cave + LFSR texture, used as an FX riser. SAND x3 clamps the noise to 1.0 over a static drone — a flat hiss. The override turns ENV2 into a 2.4 s riser generator (sustain 1.0) driving +24 st of pitch and 0.85 of filter envelope from a closed 260 Hz, so the whole sound climbs and opens for as long as the key is held; a full-size, bright CAVE carries it.

recipes.name: HOLLOW GEODE
recipes.note: NEW (anti-diagonal — the mirror of ICICLE HARP). technique 5 sync + 7 pitch-env, bell flavour. CRYSTAL x2 lands the sync partial on +11 st, a sour near-octave; +7 turns it into a struck bell. A 19 st / 45 ms chirp is the mallet, a 50% pulse gives the hollow core, and a big damped CAVE is the inside of the geode. Deliberately dry of delay so it never doubles ICICLE HARP.

recipes.name: EMBER CROWN
recipes.note: NEW (the arch: top row plus both flanks). technique 5 sync scream + 12 grind. LAVA x5 crushes to 4 bits at 0.58 mix with resonance climbing toward the screech zone — the anti-pattern list, exactly. The override pulls the crush back to a musical 6-bit 0.40 grind, drops resonance under control, and spends the headroom on a hard-synced +7 st partial and legato glide: a screaming forge lead instead of a bit-noise wall.

recipes.name: AURORA VEIL
recipes.note: NEW (edge centres, split: ICE across, GOLD through). technique 4 supersquare + 1 PWM, the bright counterpart to PERMAFROST. Plain craft lands almost on top of PERMAFROST's neighbourhood (unison railed at 8, release clamped near 5 s, cave 0.55), so the override drives them apart: thin 30% pulse, fast light PWM, 7.6 kHz air, short bloom instead of a 5 s tail, and dotted-1/4 ping-pong shimmer where PERMAFROST has a dark cavern.

recipes.name: SINKHOLE
recipes.note: NEW (full ring of OBSIDIAN — the counterpart to STRATOSPHERE's cloud ring). The FX drop. OBSIDIAN x8 clamps oscA to oct -2 and buries the cutoff, so plain craft is a barely audible rumble. The override puts the oscillator back at pitch and spends ENV2 on a 1.8 s fall: -26 st of pitch and an inverted -0.7 filter envelope closing as it goes, over a full-size dark CAVE. Hold a chord and the floor gives way.
